signal_text: A Gumroad help center article (dated July 22, 2024) stated that NSFW products must be tagged via toggle and will only be displayed to buyers who opt in to see adult content, and that sellers can improve Discover placement by agreeing to an increased Discover fee charged only on Discover-originated sales.
subject_exact: Gumroad Discover NSFW content opt-in gate and optional increased Discover fee for promotional placement
local_qualifiers: only charged when a sale occurs after it was found on Discover
does not apply to any sales made to the product outside of Discover
extraction_notes: Promotional fee amount not specified — only described as 'increased'. Fee is performance-based (triggered by Discover-originated sale). NSFW content requires buyer opt-in toggle. Metric value is unspecified in source.
